instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Tailwind CSS + Lucide icons + Framer Motion in React .js files.
Bilingual support is built-in with a top navigation toggle (ES / EN) affecting all texts, labels, and placeholders seamlessly using an intuitive context or state.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or standard framer-motion stagger-line reveals in the hero section.
Create the Lead Capture form connected to an API handler (FastAPI backend /api/leads with MongoDB or memory fallback) providing visual feedback using Sonner toast.
Ensure every interactive element has the respective data-testid attribute defined in this document.
